# ONEOFFICEAUTOMATION

> Enterprise intelligent-automation platform. Automations are OOA Flow JSON documents executed by the Runner;
> every command is a signed package; AI agents call published automations as tools through one governed AI Gateway.

This repository holds the contracts and the Python reference implementation (MVP slice 1 + agentic layer).
The production platform is Java 21; it must pass the same conformance suite.

## Contracts
- [OOA Flow v1 JSON Schema](../contracts/flow-schema/flow.v1.json): kinds TaskBot, ApiTask, Process, Form, Agent; steps are a tree addressed `package/action`
- [Conformance suite](../contracts/conformance/README.md): language-neutral cases every Runner must pass

## Writing a Flow (rules an LLM must follow)
- Every variable used as `$name` must be declared in `variables` with a type: String, Number, Boolean, DateTime, List, Dictionary, Table, Record, File, Window, UIElement, Credential, Any, Time (14:30:05), TimeSpan (ISO 8601 such as PT2H15M; also read from 2h 15m or 01:30:00), Image (picture in memory; JSON {"$binary": Base64, "mime": "image/png", "width", "height"}), Binary (bytes in memory; JSON {"$binary": Base64, "mime"})
- Argument values: literal; `"$a.b[0]"` reference (keeps type); `"text ${name} ${len($xs)}"` interpolation; `{"expr": "$a * 2"}` expression; `{"literal": "$x"}` escape
- Conditions: expression string, `{"op": "gt", "left": ..., "right": ...}`, `{"all": [...]}`, `{"any": [...]}`, `{"not": ...}`, or `{"condition": "package/condition", "args": {...}}`
- Containers: `core/if` (children, elseIf, else), `core/loop` (iterator times|while|list|dictionary|table_rows|package/iterator, `as`, `index`), `core/try` (children, catch[codes, as], finally), `core/step`, `core/parallel`
- Variables: `core/set` (`variable`, `value`); `core/set_many` (`assignments`: [{`variable`, `value`}], run in order so a row sees the rows above it)
- Containers: `core/if` (children, elseIf, else), `core/switch` (args value, match equals|contains|starts_with|ends_with|regex|expression, ignore_case; cases[values, children], default; first matching case only),`core/loop` (iterator times|while|list|dictionary|table_rows|package/iterator, `as`, `index`), `core/try` (children, catch[codes, as], finally), `core/step`, `core/parallel`
- Agent-wide error handler: top-level `"onError": {"as": "err", "steps": [...], "then": "fail"|"succeed", "screenshot": true}` runs once when an error escapes every `core/try`, before sessions close; `err` (a declared Dictionary) holds code, message, suggestedFix, stepId, line, action, stack. `fail` (default) keeps the original error; Stop and cancel do not start it; step ids are unique across `steps` and `onError.steps`
- Action outputs map to variables with `"out": {"outputName": "variableName"}`
- Credentials are passed as `{"$credential": "locker/credential/attribute"}`; they can never be interpolated or copied to text
- Expression functions: upper lower trim len concat contains startsWith endsWith replace substring split join toNumber toString toBoolean round abs min max sum now today dateAdd dateDiff formatDate parseDate coalesce isEmpty keys values get regexMatch regexExtract jsonParse jsonStringify if guid first last union intersection base64Encode base64Decode uriEncode uriDecode
- Expression functions: upper lower trim len concat contains startsWith endsWith replace substring split join toNumber toString toBoolean round abs min max sum now today dateAdd dateDiff formatDate parseDate coalesce isEmpty keys values get regexMatch regexExtract jsonParse jsonStringify if time timeSpan timeBetween totalSeconds totalMinutes totalHours totalDays imageWidth imageHeight binaryLength toBase64 fromBase64 (DateTime or Time + TimeSpan works with + and -; the time between two dates is timeBetween(a, b))
- Run `ooa manifest` for every action's inputs, outputs and descriptions; run `ooa validate FILE` before publishing

## Agents
- An Agent Flow declares `agent.instructions`, `agent.tools` (published automation ids; `sensitive: true` requires human approval), `maxSteps`, `maxCostUsd`, optional `outputSchema`
- A tool's input schema is the automation's input variables; its result is the output variables

## Errors
Every error has `code`, `message`, `suggestedFix`, `retryable`, `stepId`. Catch blocks match codes or prefixes (`BUSINESS.*`).
